description: This Java class 'SqlJdbcUtil' provides utility methods for constructing SQL clauses, handling JDBC data types, and binding values for database operations within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for creating FROM, WHERE, ORDER BY clauses, and for setting/getting values from ResultSet and PreparedStatement objects, with support for various data types and database-specific join styles.

classes.name: SqlJdbcUtil
classes.description: Utility class for constructing SQL clauses, handling JDBC data types, and binding values within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: makeFromClause
methods.description: Constructs the FROM clause with optional JOINs based on ModelEntity and datasource join style.

methods.name: makeWhereStringFromFields
methods.description: Builds a WHERE clause string with conditions based on provided fields and operators.

methods.name: makeWhereClause
methods.description: Creates a complete WHERE clause including optional conditions and view entity joins.

methods.name: makeViewWhereClause
methods.description: Generates a WHERE clause for view entities based on join style and entity relationships.

methods.name: filterColName
methods.description: Sanitizes column names by replacing special characters with underscores.

methods.name: setValues
methods.description: Binds a list of ModelFields' values from an entity to an SQL processor.

methods.name: setValuesWhereClause
methods.description: Binds ModelFields' values from a dummy value to an SQL processor for WHERE clauses, skipping nulls.

methods.name: setPkValues
methods.description: Binds primary key values from an entity to an SQL processor.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves and converts a value from a ResultSet into an entity's field, handling various data types and encryption.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a value into an SQL processor for a specific ModelField, handling data type conversions and encryption.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Maps Java type names to internal type codes used for JDBC operations.

methods.name: addValueSingle
methods.description: Appends a single value condition to SQL, with parameter binding support.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Appends a collection of values or a single value to SQL conditions, supporting IN clauses.
